rules.statement: Support for this measure starts with application year 2025.

result.description: The measure can be supported in the year.

rules.statement: The commitment and contract period is one calendar year; annual participation renews automatically unless deregistered.

result.description: Obligations run from 1 January through 31 December.

rules.statement: Both categories must be requested in the multiple application before contract start, no later than 31 December; final entry is 2027 via application by 31 December 2026.

result.description: Late applications do not establish the stated contract.

rules.statement: Nonproductive arable land must be declared as use type Grünbrache and marked with code NPA.

conditions.description: Parcel is claimed as nonproductive arable land.

result.description: The specified use type and code are required.

rules.statement: Agroforestry strips must be declared as LSE Agroforststreifen in the participation year, and all claimed strips must be managed under this measure's obligations.

result.description: All claimed strips are subject to the obligations.

rules.statement: Nonproductive arable land must be newly sown (self-greening permitted) or consist of retained existing green fallow or permanently green arable land.

conditions.description: Parcel is in the NPA category.

result.description: Only the listed establishment alternatives are compliant.

rules.statement: New sowing is due by 15 May; tillage is allowed from 15 September, or from 1 August where a subsequent winter crop or cover crop is planted.

conditions.description: New NPA sowing or tillage occurs.

result.description: The sowing and tillage dates satisfy the applicable deadline.

rules.statement: From 1 January of first declaration as NPA until tillage or another declaration, fertilization and plant-protection products are prohibited, except products exclusively containing substances permitted by Regulation (EU) 2018/848.

result.description: No fertilizer and no non-Bio-848-only plant-protection product may be used.

rules.statement: NPA may only be removed mechanically, by mulching or incorporation; the information sheet specifies soil-working equipment as mechanical methods.

result.description: Removal is limited to mulching or incorporation.

rules.statement: A maintenance mow without removal or mulching is required at least once every second year and allowed at most twice yearly; on 50% of NPA it is only allowed from 1 August, while the other 50% has no date restriction.

result.description: Maintenance frequency and the 50% late-management share apply.

rules.statement: A weed-control cleaning cut before 1 August is allowed only in the first application year on newly sown areas (including autumn or following-spring sowing); it is outside the twice-yearly limit and 50% share. It is not allowed on retained green fallow unless that fallow is tilled and newly sown.

result.description: The early cut is permitted only for the stated newly sown case.

rules.statement: NPA biomass may not be removed or used, grazing is prohibited, and after tillage the parcel remains subject to a use ban through 31 December.

conditions.description: NPA parcel is managed or tilled.

result.description: No grazing or biomass use, including after tillage through year end.

rules.statement: An agroforestry strip is a wooded element newly established from 2020, directly adjoining arable land, not a special crop, and not containing a species on the negative list; shrubs between trees are allowed.

conditions.description: Parcel is claimed as agroforestry strip.

result.description: All structural definition requirements are met.

rules.statement: Agroforestry strips require average width 2–10 m, 10–25 trees per 100 running metres, and maximum tree spacing of 15 m.

result.description: All width, density and spacing thresholds are met.

rules.statement: The 14 species/genera in the negative list may not occur in agroforestry strips; the information sheet also requires their removal if they establish through natural spread.

conditions.description: Tree species in a strip are assessed.

result.description: No prohibited taxon occurs; naturally arriving prohibited taxa are removed.

rules.statement: An agroforestry strip may not adjoin forest or a planar landscape element along its long side.

result.description: No prohibited long-side adjacency exists.

rules.statement: New agroforestry establishment must occur by 15 May of the application year; tree removal is allowed only if minimum criteria remain met or replacement planting occurs by 15 May of that year.

result.description: Date and continuing minimum-criteria condition are met.

rules.statement: Trees must be cared for so they establish and develop into an agroforestry strip; indispensable care includes stakes after planting, browsing protection and need-based pruning.

result.description: Establishment-supporting care is carried out.

rules.statement: The herbaceous area must remain permanently green; its use by mowing or grazing is prohibited, while maintenance mowing without removal or mulching is allowed.

result.description: Permanent green cover is retained and no productive use occurs.

rules.statement: Fertilizer and plant-protection products are generally prohibited across the entire agroforestry area during the contract period; only browsing protection permitted under Regulation (EU) 2018/848 for trees and shrubs is allowed.

conditions.description: Input use on the strip is assessed.

result.description: No fertilizer and no unallowed plant-protection product is used.

rules.statement: NPA is eligible only up to 4% of arable area, with a premium band of EUR 350–450/ha from 2025; the stated minimum is guaranteed and the payment within the band depends on claimed areas and available funds.

result.description: EUR 350–450 per eligible hectare, subject to band allocation.

rules.statement: Agroforestry strips have a premium band of EUR 600–800/ha from 2025; the stated minimum is guaranteed and allocation within the band depends on claimed areas and available funds.

result.description: EUR 600–800 per eligible hectare, subject to band allocation.

rules.statement: NPA is not premium-combinable with any other measure on the individual area and cannot count toward other obligations under the Special Directive.

conditions.description: Same individual area is claimed for another measure or obligation.

result.description: No second measure premium or other-obligation credit is available.

rules.statement: NPA designated as a GLÖZ 4 area is not eligible on the affected part.

conditions.description: Affected NPA part is a GLÖZ 4 buffer.

result.description: No NPA premium for the affected part.

rules.statement: In the first ÖPUL participation year, a farm needs either 0.50 ha protected cultivation or 1.50 ha aggregate qualifying land; from the second year this general farm minimum is not required.

result.description: One of the stated area minima is met.

rules.statement: Supported land must be in Austria and obligations must be met for the entire calendar-year commitment; a transferred parcel remains eligible only if the receiving farm continues it through the obligation period, otherwise it must be reported and receives no premium for the incomplete year.

conditions.description: Parcel is claimed under the measure.

result.description: Austrian location and full-period compliance are required.

rules.statement: The same performance is not eligible where it is financed from another public title or is legally/administratively required, subject to the stated exceptions for Natura 2000 and Water Framework Directive measures.

conditions.expression: same performance has public funding or binding public requirement

result.description: No duplicate compensation for the same performance.

rules.statement: All measure premiums are modulated by total farm area: 100% to 200 ha, 90% for the next 100 ha, 85% for the next 700 ha, and 75% above 1,000 ha.

result.description: The payment factor is the area-weighted result of the four brackets.

rules.statement: Substantive breaches are assessed by seriousness, extent, duration and frequency, with warning or 2%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 50% or 100% reduction; two 100% reductions during the contract period lead to exclusion and recovery. From 2027, the warning is replaced by a 1% withholding.

result.description: Sanction is determined under the stated graduated system.

rules.statement: A farm participating in UBB or Biologische Wirtschaftsweise cannot simultaneously participate in the nonproductive-arable category, except BIO part-farm participation limited to wine, fruit and hops.

result.description: NPA category cannot be combined with the stated participation, subject to the explicit BIO part-farm exception.

rules.statement: Agroforestry strips assigned to a field parcel count toward the at-least 0.15 ha biodiversity-area requirement on arable field parcels over 5.00 ha for UBB or BIO.

result.description: Assigned agroforestry area is credited to that specific field-parcel requirement.

rules.statement: From 2025, NPA and agroforestry payments are excluded from the EUR 1,300/ha cap for the sum of ordinary area-related payments.

result.description: O6_1C payment does not consume the stated ordinary EUR 1,300/ha ceiling.
